note: Re-judged at HEAD against RFC 4271 Section 4.3 ("For well-known attributes and for optional non-transitive attributes, the Partial bit MUST be set to 0."). Positive: TestRFC4271PartialBitClearOnSend checks encoded flags of all well-known attributes and MED; TestRFC4271PartialClearedOnTheRelayedWire proves ORIGIN 0x60 and MED 0xA0 are cleared to 0x40 and 0x80 on route-server relay via publishBase -> ClearPartialOnWellKnownAndNonTransitive while COMMUNITIES 0xE0 preserves Partial; TestRFC4271PartialNotSetOnRecognizedOrNonTransitive checks reactor publish. Negative: TestRFC4271PartialNotStampedOnExcludedClasses proves SetPartialOnUnrecognizedTransitive never stamps well-known or optional non-transitive attributes; TestRFC4271PartialClearedWhenTheRailReadvertises and TestRFC4271PartialBitClearedOnReadvertisedWellKnown prove commit and storage readvertise rails clear Partial on received 0x60/0xA0 inputs.
